hand.beat_list: the DP list is KEPT (the Malicious precedent, §72: 'phase corrected, beat list kept'), the lattice recorded here as the validated figure. Why: the ear could not separate them, so the rule is which list the harness's consumers are built on — every consumer of `beats` / `downbeats` is on the DP list: clicktrack.py (grid A, heard), kicktruth.py / snaretruth.py (the .kick.json / .snare.json beat-slot stats, grid16 off the truth beats: beat-slots [226 105 224 45]), dropcheck.py / predcheck.py / queuecheck.py (the beat unit and the bar / beat events), gridcheck.py, tongues-cold.js, and windows.py's drops + sections (bar-pinned to the DP downbeats: the windows.json shots and the §117 real-md5 / real-rulers reference lines rest on them). The map (assets/engine/map) builds its own grid from the audio and reads neither list. Swapping to the lattice would move the drops 2.4–8.9 ms off their bar pin and re-bin the kick / snare slot stats for no gain the ear can hear.
